metadata.description: muningis' personal Claude Code skills & plugins marketplace

plugins.name: recap
plugins.description: Summarize what you worked on across Claude Code sessions since the last recap — a ready-to-paste standup of the tasks you actually drove, grouped by project.

plugins.name: scruff
plugins.description: Mentor mode: teach, don't type. Scruff briefs you on the structure and verified doc links to build it yourself, keeps its paws off your files, then grabs you by the scruff at review time and grills what you built — every criticism backed by proof, not vibes.

plugins.name: kit
plugins.description: Kit out a repo with code intelligence: detect the languages it uses, fetch the matching language servers, and enable the LSP plugins in that repo's own .claude/settings.json — scoped there, nothing global.

plugins.name: ratchet
plugins.description: Plan-and-verify workflow: grill, PRD/spec/design log, roast, then small checkpoints that a deterministic engine pushes through red tests, behaviour, visual, two blind reviewers (findings block only with a proof or a rule ID) and your approval. Also fix, verify, handover/resume and why flows, STE-lite doc checks, and a nightly dream that reads all your sessions and proposes rules for you to approve.

plugins.name: den
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod: pixel-art raccoons act out what Claude and its subagents are doing, in a docked pane — and go full frenzy during a ratchet run (crew stations, minion conveyor, sirens, YOUR TURN sign, gear clicks, confetti). /den demo shows it all.
